svg.title: Core Web Vitals pass rate, desktop (traditional open-source)
svg.desc: Share of origins passing all Core Web Vitals on desktop devices for WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, TYPO3, Craft CMS, monthly from 2020-01 to 2026-09, from the HTTP Archive Tech Report. A dashed vertical line marks March 2024, when INP replaced FID in the definition, so the series is not strictly comparable across it. This is origin-level field data, not a controlled benchmark.
svg.text: Core Web Vitals pass rate, desktop (traditional open-source)
Origins passing Core Web Vitals, desktop (%)

text.tspan: Source: HTTP Archive Tech Report (cdn.httparchive.org/v1/cwv); retrieved 2026-10-29. Survivor bias may flatter small populations. Raw data:
scripts/cms-comparison-charts/data/performance.csv. See the Bibliography for the sources.
